# Feature Spec: No Edge Case Section

## Problem / Goal

This spec has common words like error and null in body text but no dedicated edge case section.

## Actors

- User handles ErrorActionPreference settings
- System returns null on success

## Scenarios

- User submits an empty form
- The error log is rotated daily

## Functional Requirements

- FR1: System shall process data

## Non-Functional Requirements

- NFR1: Uptime 99.9%

## Success Criteria

- Deployment succeeds

## Out of Scope

- Internationalization

**Version**: 1.0
